jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

In this role, you will lead the Gas Services Central Service Procurement (SO2) Service Operations 2 Team, overseeing sourcing and operational activities for parts and tools across four Regional Service Units and inventory.

Your primary focus will be on driving cost-out initiatives, achieving >95% on-time delivery, and building a resilient, high-performing supply chain. You will work closely with Global Service Operations (GSO), Project Management, Commodity Management, Supplier Quality, and Regional Service Procurement teams to align business needs with sourcing strategies and order fulfillment processes.

Beyond meeting key procurement metrics, you will foster a customer-centric approach in all activities. A critical aspect of your role is to navigate diverse interests in a matrixed, multicultural environment, while building and maintaining a highly engaged, motivated team—positioning Procurement as an aspirational workplace: “Procurement is a place to be.”

How You’ll Make an Impact 
* Lead the Gas Services Central Service Procurement (SO2) Service Operations 2 Team, overseeing sourcing and operational activities for parts and tools.
* Drive cost-out initiatives and achieve over 95% on-time delivery while building a resilient supply chain.
* Collaborate with Global Service Operations (GSO), Project Management, Commodity Management, Supplier Quality, and Regional Service Procurement teams to align business needs with sourcing strategies.
* Foster a customer-centric approach in all activities, ensuring procurement metrics are met.
* Build and maintain a highly engaged, motivated team in a matrixed, multicultural environment.

What You Bring
* A university degree in a technical or business-related field.
* Extensive experience in both operational and strategic procurement roles.
* A focused, driven, and empathetic leadership style.
* Strong negotiation skills with the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
* Proven track record in developing and maintaining strong supplier relationships.
* Fluency in English and German, along with outstanding communication and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day 

In your new role as a Release (Train) Engineer you will be responsible for the overall team performance on tactical level. You enable the maximum performance of our multiple teams, remove overall impediments, and ensure high discipline and consequence in agile working throughout our agile team organization, the Agile Release Train (ART).

This model consists of three levels. At the strategic level, we plan and prioritize initiatives with 12+ month horizon through a portfolio epic roadmap, defined and prioritized by product managers. The tactical level focuses on organizing and prioritizing ART epics for a one-year horizon and ART features with a maximum duration of 12 weeks, to be delivered within one Planning Interval. The operational level – the team level - involves planning and executing User Stories and Tasks within a sprint, using Scrum methodologies. This integrated approach aims to enhance our development efficiency and responsiveness to market demands.

How You’ll Make an Impact 

* Organize and lead the Program Increment (PI) Planning sessions to ensure that all teams and stakeholders are aligned on common goals and deliverables
* Oversee the activities of the Agile Release Train (ART) and ensure that teams are working  collaboratively towards shared objectives and removing obstacles
* Identify, track, and mitigate risks and dependencies across teams to ensure smooth delivery of features and capabilities
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, byfacilitating engaging retrospectives and implement feedback mechanisms that empower teams to enhance their performance and achieve excellence
* Provide regular updates on ART progress, including metrics and performance indicators, to stakeholders and leadership
* As a champion of SAFe principles and practices, you’ll advocate for agile methodologies, ensuring that the ART adheres to best practices and continuously evolves to meet the demands of a fast-paced environment
* With your profound knowledge and expertise you contribute to the Lean Agile Center of Excellence (LACE) to enable relentless improvement of the overall agile organization

What You Bring

* Completed university degree in a technical or commercial field
* Long-term experience as a Release (Train) Engineer (f/m/d)
* Certification as a SAFe Release Train Engineer
* Willingness to travel (up to 10 percent) and work in an international environment
